capabilities: Organize case notes in a Specialty → Surgeon → Case hierarchy
Create case notes and surgeon profiles from included templates
Record glove and gown data per surgeon
Navigate between specialties, surgeons, and cases on desktop and mobile
Export the library as an offline .cstpack for PeriSlate Cards
extras: Proprietary, closed-source software; source is available to the Obsidian Community Directory only for review via a private repository. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No payment, account, or telemetry is required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for surgical technologist case documentation, such as specialty and surgeon organization or glove and gown data.

relations.evidence: prepares a single offline .cstpack for PeriSlate Cards

summary: Organizes surgical technologist case notes in a Specialty → Surgeon → Case hierarchy with templates, surgeon profiles, and offline .cstpack export.
